answer.short: At least two pairs of equal corresponding angles (AAA).
answer.worked: $\angle B=\angle E=70^\circ$ and $\angle C=\angle F=48^\circ$. Therefore $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEF$, since at least two pairs of corresponding angles are equal.

$DF$ corresponds to $AC$, and $DE$ corresponds to $AB$.
